claim: The cause of a named-profile launch registering no project (in _hub_resolve_launch_url / _fetch_setup_token) should be investigated, after which the drive's POST /projects/open fallback should be removed.

citations.quote: Investigate why a launch on a named profile registers no project (_hub_resolve_launch_url / _fetch_setup_token), then remove the drive's POST /projects/open fallback.
